**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear Madam,
I send herewith a copy of [Heartsease leaves](../books.html#45), but I am afraid I must ask you to return it. I had some copies once sold for a bazaar, but they are all gone now, except one or two for home consumption of which I send one.
I am glad that the [Christian names](../books.html#48) gave you any amusement

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: This letter evidently predates the republication of Last Heartsease Leaves as \'Lost Heartsease Leaves\' in Events of the Month (January 1865).
